candidates.title: Run the cheapest candidate falsifier

hypothesis_discrimination_targets.discriminating_observation: The cheapest registered falsifier separates the target hypothesis from the competing ordinary process.
hypothesis_discrimination_targets.expected_if_hypothesis: The target pattern survives the falsifier.
hypothesis_discrimination_targets.expected_if_alternative: The pattern follows the ordinary competing process or disappears.
hypothesis_discrimination_targets.would_weaken_if: The target pattern disappears or follows the competing process under the falsifier.

candidates.rationale: Eliminates an ill-typed or non-tangent candidate before expensive work.
